title: President (Scum)
flash.revolutionEnd: Revolution ended — strength order back to normal
tutorial.cpuArea: Card counts for the three CPU opponents.
tutorial.tableCards: The current play on the table — you must beat it with the same number of cards but higher rank.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click cards to select, then press Play to put them down.
tutorial.playPass: Play to put the selected cards down, or Pass to skip your turn.
tutorial.welcome: Welcome to President! Get rid of your cards to become President; be last and you're the Scum.

frontendHint.presidentLead: The table is clear — lead your weakest card
frontendHint.presidentLeadRevolution: A revolution has inverted the order — lead what is weakest now
frontendHint.presidentFollow: Play the weakest card that still beats the table
frontendHint.presidentFollowRevolution: The order is inverted — play the weakest card that beats the table now
frontendHint.presidentPass: Nothing in hand beats the table — pass

settings.revolutionHelp: Triggered when 4 or more cards are played at once. Inverts the strength of all cards.
settings.cardExchangeHelp: At the start of a round, President (1st) and Scum (4th) exchange 2 cards, and Vice President (2nd) and Vice Scum (3rd) exchange 1 card. The lower rank gives their strongest cards, and the higher rank gives their weakest cards.
settings.passFieldFlushHelp: When any player passes, the table is immediately cleared, allowing the next player to play any cards.
